note: THE CANONICAL A04 RENDERING FIXTURE, frozen from the closure run of 1 October 2026. Christian: "use the exact A04 concrete game from this closure run as the canonical rendering fixture. For this first test, do not reselect or re-realize it." So rendering reads THIS artifact and never a fresh run - which is what isolates the rendering boundary from the chain that produced it. If a later run would produce a different game, that is a separate finding and this file does not move.

provenance.registerVersion: 4, adds BY_CONSTRUCTION, the Rules-area Action Restriction, and Performer Participation State (Christian, 2026-09-24)

position.along: attacking end (of the team J3 names for the objective referencing it; EACH_TEAM if shared): touches an end line, not the interior
position.across: extends across the axis: the target lies across the direction of progression

along.asAuthored: attacking end (of the team J3 names for the objective referencing it; EACH_TEAM if shared): touches an end line, not the interior
along.why: the prose test is "touches the end line T attacks", which fixes one edge and states no depth The element's noun gives it extent in one dimension and its other axis carries that extent, so its extent on this axis is zero.

across.asAuthored: extends across the axis: the target lies across the direction of progression
across.why: An element spanning the whole of an axis, which is what "end line to end line" and "extends across the axis" both state. Axis-free, so one term serves both. APPROVED by Christian 1 October as a canonical addition to RC-21; no parallel spatial representation is kept beside it.
